verdict.rationale: Pendo documents a self-serve API endpoint for bulk deleting accounts and visitors without contacting support, which covers the deletion half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable data retention periods or policies; on-device session replay masking is a separate privacy control and does not count toward retention. Missing for 10: configurable data retention periods/policies, in-app (no-code) deletion controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can use the API endpoint to delete accounts and visitors without contacting our support team.
